title: Research: all-puncture E8 star decoder exclusion and p=56 classification (seed 49, no new kappa)

body:
## Summary & Status

- **Status:** Research note / scoped negative result (**no new $\kappa$**; `certificates/selected-result.json` and `upstream/` are unchanged).
- **Track & Seed:** Track 40–49 (Structural decoder research), OS random seed `49`.
- **Base Commit:** `ce7ad1b6ab09452c3478723a2e96ed5ff212dc08`
- **Predecessors Extended:** PR #631 (Chi Zhao, `0 <= p <= 35`), PR #875 (Philipp / `@mightyOil`, `p = 36`), and PR #939 (Ross Richardson, `0 <= p <= 55`).

## What Changed / Was Learned

PR #939 excluded the $E_8$ root-only star label-decoder from improving on the 9-puncture ratio $63/111$ up to $p \le 55$ and stopped at $p = 55$ because at $p = 56$ a minimum-weight codeword $c_0 \in C$ ($\operatorname{wt}(c_0)=56$) can vanish on the 64 live ports $L = \{0,\dots,119\}\setminus P$, dropping the live binary label rank $\dim_{\mathbb{F}_2}(C|_L)$ from $9$ to $8$. Moreover, the pairwise ($k \le 2$) capacity inequality $M_a + M_b \ge 84 - p$ used in PR #939 fails at $p = 72$ ($27/48 = 9/16 < 63/111$) and across $78 \le p \le 119$ (collapsing to $0$ for $p \ge 84$).

This package (`research/e8-star-all-punctures-seed49/`) resolves the remaining range $56 \le p \le 119$ and classifies the $p = 56$ dimension-loss boundary:

1. **Proposition 1 (Live-Quotient Star Cost Equivalence under Dimension Loss):** For any puncture set $P$ with $0 \le p \le 119$ ($1 \le v = 120 - p \le 120$) and restriction kernel $K_P = \{c \in C : \operatorname{supp}(c) \subseteq P\}$ of dimension $k_0 = 9 - \dim_{\mathbb{F}_2}(C|_L) \in \{0,\dots,8\}$, surviving rational star rank $s_P(c)$ is constant on cosets of $C / K_P \cong C|_L$ and vanishes iff $c \in K_P$. Thus the minimum star cost over $(9-k_0)$-element bases of the live quotient $C|_L$ equals the minimum star cost $C_{\text{star}}(P)$ over 9-element bases of $C$.
2. **Proposition 2 (Complete Two-Orbit Classification at the $p=56$ Boundary):** The $255$ puncture sets of size $p = 56$ with $\dim_{\mathbb{F}_2}(C|_L) < 9$ are the supports of the $255$ weight-$56$ codewords of $C$ (all with $k_0 = 1$, $\dim_{\mathbb{F}_2}(C|_L) = 8$), which partition under $W(E_8)$ into two orbits:
   - **Orbit 1 ($135$ even-frame codewords):** 511-reader rank histogram $\{0:1,\; 7:112,\; 8:398\}$, cumulative $\mathbb{F}_2$-dimensions $(1,1,1,1,1,1,1,8,9)$, exact optimal basis $(0,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,8)$ of star cost **$57$ on $64$ ports** ($57/64 = 0.890625 > 63/111$). All $56$ single-port restorations ($p=55$) restore $\dim_{\mathbb{F}_2}(C|_L)=9$ with cost $58$.
   - **Orbit 2 ($120$ root-nonorthogonality supports $S_a = \{i : |\langle L_i, L_a \rangle| = 4\}$):** live ports $\{a\} \cup a^\perp$ ($1+63=64$ lines), 511-reader rank histogram $\{0:1,\; 6:56,\; 7:198,\; 8:256\}$, cumulative $\mathbb{F}_2$-dimensions $(1,1,1,1,1,1,8,8,9)$, exact optimal basis $(0,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,8)$ of star cost **$50$ on $64$ ports** ($50/64 = 25/32 = 0.78125 > 63/111$). All $56$ single-port restorations ($p=55$) restore $\dim_{\mathbb{F}_2}(C|_L)=9$ with cost $51$.
3. **Proposition 3 (Sharp Subspace Support-Union Hierarchy, $k=1,\dots,9$):** The minimum support union of a $k$-dimensional subspace $W_k \subseteq C$ is sharply
   $$(U_1, U_2, U_3, U_4, U_5, U_6, U_7, U_8, U_9) = (56, 84, 100, 108, 112, 116, 118, 119, 120),$$
   attained simultaneously by a single nested full flag $0 \subset W_1 \subset \dots \subset W_9 = C$.
4. **Theorem 4 (All-Puncture $0 \le p \le 119$ Ratio Exclusion):** Imposing $\delta_{d_i} \le p$ and $\sum_{i=1}^k M_{d_i} \ge U_k - p$ ($1 \le k \le 9$) across all $24{,}310$ sorted rank profiles (with PR #631's $72-p$ for $0 \le p \le 8$) proves $C_{\text{star}}^{\text{live}}(P)/(120-p) = C_{\text{star}}(P)/(120-p) \ge 63/111$ for all $0 \le p \le 119$, with equality possible only at $p = 9$.

## Reproducible Verification Commands

```bash
python3 -I -O -B research/e8-star-all-punctures-seed49/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/e8-star-all-punctures-seed49/independent_check.py
python3 -I -O -B research/e8-star-all-punctures-seed49/test_package.py
```

## Scope, Attribution & AI Disclosure

- **Scope:** Applies strictly to the real $E_8$ root-only star label-decoder cost model $C_{\text{star}}(P)$ defined in PR #631 and PR #939; does not claim a formal proof of the asymptotic multiplication theorem or exclude non-star/multi-stage decoders.
